mapper.select: select p.id,p.playlist_name,p.cover_url,p.is_public,p.music_count,p.play_count, p.description,p.user_id,u.username,c.updated_time from playlist as p left join user as u on p.user_id=u.id left join user_collection as c on p.id=c.target_id where p.id=#{targetId} and c.user_id=#{userId}
